title: Impuesto al patrimonio: una propuesta tributaria deficiente
by: Hermann González, Felipe Larraín and Óscar Perelló (Estudios Públicos, CEP)
note: Argues against a wealth tax for Chile: capital flight and low revenue.

title: 순부유세 도입 시 문제점에 관한 연구 (The Study on the Introduction of the Net Wealth Tax in Korea)
by: Young Hoon Kim, Park Sung Ook and Juneq Lee (Kyung Hee University), 회계저널 vol. 23 no. 5
note: Argues against a net wealth tax in Korea: administration cost, constitutional doubts, double taxation.

title: Czy podatek majątkowy może uzdrowić finanse publiczne i zmniejszyć nierówności majątkowe w Polsce?
note: Concludes that a net wealth tax in Poland would do little for inequality and cost too much.

title: Konsekvenser af en formueskat i Danmark (Consequences of a wealth tax in Denmark)
note: CEPOS analysis arguing against the Social Democrats' wealth tax.

title: Formueskatten vil gøre Danmark fattigere (The wealth tax will make Denmark poorer)
by: Troels Chr. Nielsen Boesen and Christian Bartels Kastrup, Dansk Industri
note: Employers' organisation analysis arguing against the Social Democrats' wealth tax.

title: Dokument 8:77 S (2011–2012): Representantforslag om opphevelse av formuesskatt på arbeidende kapital
by: Ketil Solvik-Olsen, Hans Frode Kielland Asmyhr, Harald T. Nesvik and Ulf Leirstein (FrP)
note: Progress Party proposal to abolish the wealth tax on working capital.

title: Dokument 8:110 S (2021–2022): Representantforslag om å utsette innføringen av formuesskatt på oppdrettstillatelser
by: Helge André Njåstad, Roy Steffensen, Bengt Rune Strifeldt, Frank Edvard Sve and Erlend Wiborg (FrP)
note: Progress Party proposal to postpone and reassess the wealth tax on aquaculture concessions.
